column1: # Review tiers for scripts/review-tier.sh: none = no independent review, logic = up to three rounds, security = up to five.
# Columns (tab-separated): tier, kind, extended regex matched case-insensitively.
# Kinds: path = the changed file's path matches; content = a changed line or its hunk's context line matches;
#        lines = every changed non-blank line matches.
# Per file the first applicable row wins and an unmatched file is logic; the change takes its highest file tier.
# Order security before instruction documents before none, so a misclassification can only raise a tier.
# A repository extends this list with .review-tiers.tsv at its root, read from the review base; its rows go first.
